title: Interactive Teaching Platform for Power Flow and N-1 Analysis (IEEE 14-bus)
description: Open-source platform for teaching steady-state security analysis on the IEEE 14-bus system: 24 hourly scenarios from open data of the Brazilian system operator (ONS), N-1 analysis of every branch, generator reactive-power limits, provisional branch ratings, contingency ranking and a corrective-action laboratory. Built with pandapower and Streamlit. Includes a script that regenerates every table and figure of the accompanying article.
